content:
Maya: quick sync — planning a sequenced bump window today. order: API -> runtime -> console -> sdk. cutoff for PRs is 20:00 UTC (3pm PT). please ack and call blockers.
Alex: ack. I'll prepare the runtime bump PR and hold canary until api tag is live.
Priya: heads up — runtime change touches auth header handling. will need an API minor that keeps a compat shim. is that in scope?
Maya: yes, API will publish 1.3.0 with shim. @Nova to merge. Alex: hold runtime until nova/api#123 is merged.
Alex: got it. will queue canary after merge.
release-bot: CI passed for nova/api#123 — all checks green :white_check_mark:
Jun: tagging/changelog note — remember to update CHANGELOG.md in each repo. use header format: 'Release vX.Y.Z — YYYY-MM-DD'.
Maya: checklist (quick):
```
- api: bump to 1.3.0, tag, changelog
- runtime: bump to 0.14.2, add fallback policy, default off for new flag
- console: update SDK deps, add UI migration note
- sdk-js: bump peer deps and update README
```
Maya: owners: @Nova (api), @Alex (runtime), @Irene (console), @Sam (sdk-js). add reviewers and tag release-team on PRs.
Irene: console has a small design-system conflict; will open PR in ~30m.
Sam: sdk-js needs a docs snippet update for auth changes — will followup.
Priya: suggestion — runtime should include a fallback to previous model variant in config to avoid cutover risk.
Alex: good call; adding fallback config to runtime PR.
Maya: aim to cut tags at 21:00 UTC if everything green. ping this thread when PRs open and when tags created :rocket:
Alex: opened runtime PR — github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/456
Irene: opened console PR — github.com/redwood/console/pull/789
Sam: sdk-js PR — github.com/redwood/sdk-js/pull/101
Nova: api PR merged and tagged v1.3.0 — github.com/redwood/api/commit/abcd1234 :tada:
release-bot: deploy pipeline queued for runtime canary — pipeline/98765
Maya: thanks — monitoring plan: Alex will watch canary logs for latency/regressions; Jun will verify changelog + release note draft. if regressions occur, roll runtime canary back.
Alex: monitoring logs now, will report spikes here.
Jun: added changelog entries for api/runtime/console/sdk-js.
Maya: last call — 10 minutes to cut.
Alex: ack
Irene: ack
Sam: ack
Nova: ack
Maya: cut complete. tags:
api@v1.3.0, runtime@v0.14.2, console@v2.8.0, sdk-js@v0.9.1
release-bot: release notes generated — draft at /releases/2025-06-01
Maya: great work everyone. I'll follow up with the final rollout checklist and a short retro tomorrow for any hiccups. :clap:
